goal: Independent review of Source OCR configuration, frozen Runs and README PDF consumption
failure_boundaries: Any of the 20 Sources or example omits the approved language or explicit 96 DPI
A genuine image-only page avoids the isolated OCR worker or loses anchors, page text, HTML or Markdown
A README derived configuration silently replaces 96 DPI with a historical default
A missing irrelevant OCR model blocks native PDF or HTML processing
Updating Source YAML mutates an already frozen Run configuration, hash or parser manifest
A historical Run without OCR configuration no longer resolves historical defaults without mutation
README storage checks accept old successful Versions after all current PDF observations fail
The documented API settings, result metadata, pagination or attachment hash contract disagrees with actual interfaces
isolation: Only fresh temporary PostgreSQL database and S3 bucket; public one-page retained inputs served over authorized loopback; credentials never included in artifacts
unverified: Current public website availability and unbounded full-site harvesting
